differences.what: the deck's cresting: a dense ring of open ironwork round the deck, where the build stood four posts and a rail
differences.how: T-1934: three rails, a bar every 0.16 m and a spear on every third, 0.75 m high, round both decks (open_cresting)

differences.what: a tall tapered spire at the deck's corners, rising well over the cresting
differences.how: T-1934: a post at each deck corner carrying a 1.2 m tapered spire over the cresting; the corners the pictures do not show carry one too (reconstructed)

differences.what: the moulded stone belt course the upper storey stands on, where the build showed the lower roof's slope as a band of slate under the upper sash (the owner named the belt course, 2026-10-28)
differences.how: T-1934: a two-member stone course, about 0.36 m deep, its top where the lower slope meets the wall (4.41 m on the 18th Street front, 4.60 m on the west face, whose slope is steeper), and the upper sash raised onto it from 4.3 m; the lower roof's eave cut on the diagonal where the upper storey turns the corner, so its square hip no longer stands in front of the corner wall

differences.what: the stable's cornices, belt course and the belvedere's cornice in the walls' light stone, where the build drew them in the dark cornice tone
differences.how: T-1934: the stable's stone mouldings drawn in the light trim stone

differences.what: the belvedere's balustrade: open balusters between plain dies, a die at each corner and at each side's middle, over a frieze and cornice (x 780-1150 px); the build had a solid rail (the owner named the open belvedere, 2026-10-28)
differences.how: T-1934: a 0.9 m balustrade on a plinth under a rail, dies at the corners and the middles, balusters at 0.24 m; a frieze band under the cornice

differences.what: the corner bay's cap: a low weathered slope from its cornice back onto the corner, where the build brought it to a point over the corner
differences.how: T-1934: a slope rising 0.6 m over 0.45 m from the cornice onto a flat lead top that runs back to the corner wall

differences.what: the north block's lower roof: the plate shows its cresting about 1.5 m further north and 0.5 m lower than the build's deck
differences.how: carried from the conservatory record; seen only in this picture, at the belvedere's edge and through a tree, with no corner of the block to place it by

differences.what: the deck's south-west corner: the plate puts its spire almost in line with the lantern, about 1 m further west than the build; Taylor's 16555, which T-3192 fitted the deck's west edge to, puts it where the build has it
the deck's height: the plate reads it about 0.4 m lower than the build, Taylor's 16554 about 0.3 m higher
differences.how: two pictures disagree; the build stands between

differences.what: the bay's place along the corner: the plate puts its lights about 0.6-0.9 m further east than the build, Taylor's 16554 about 1.4 m further west
differences.how: two pictures disagree; the build stands between them

differences.what: the main roof's corner over the bay: the plate draws one hip line; the build's eave, cut on the diagonal, carries a narrow facet up to the deck's corner
differences.how: the roof's outline and its eave line are unchanged; the facet shows as a change of shade about 1.5 m wide at the cornice, narrowing to nothing at the deck

differences.what: the lantern: the plate draws its drum as open ironwork under a broad, flat cap; the build has a glazed octagonal drum under a flat dome
differences.how: its size and height agree within about 0.3 m here; Taylor's 16554 reads its dome taller, so the pictures disagree on its height

differences.what: the belvedere's corners banded in rusticated courses, and the upper sash of two lights each in moulded frames

differences.what: the 18th Street wall across the foreground, its square piers and coping, the curved low walls by the steps, the lamps on the piers, the shrubs and the trees
differences.how: the lot's grounds, judged in the match (the owner, 2026-10-28); none of it is built
